description: This file contains unit tests for the creation of a standard logging payload, including test functions that generate payloads with varying message content. It imports modules for mocking, logging, testing, and references specific classes from the litellm package. The functions primarily serve to create instances of StandardLoggingPayload with sample data for testing purposes.

methods.name: StandardLoggingPayload create_standard_logging_payload()
methods.description: Creates a StandardLoggingPayload object with sample data for testing.
